launch.heading: Open a site in translate mode
launch.intro: The site opens with the overlay: Alt-click any text to translate it, then submit your edits as a pull request.
launch.invalid: Type the full address of a site, starting with https://
launch.link: Send this link to a translator:
try.heading: Try it on this page
try.intro: This page is translatable too. Open it in translate mode, then Alt-click this paragraph.
how.heading: How it works
how.marker: In translate mode every message a site formats carries an invisible marker, so the overlay finds it wherever it ends up: in the text, a tooltip, a placeholder.
how.check: Every edit is checked against the English message as it is typed: it must parse, and keep exactly the same placeholders.
how.pullRequest: Submitting opens one pull request per repository; a later submission from the same browser adds to it.
how.count: {count, plural, one {# catalog is registered on this page.} other {# catalogs are registered on this page.}}
setup.heading: Make a site translatable
setup.intro: A site registers its catalogs, formats every visible string with t(), and loads the overlay from this server when its address carries ?translate=.
